long_biography.plain_text:
Turner is one of four children of industrialist Oscar Davis. After acquiring a metal foundry in 1964, Davis used his plastics experience to reshape Hayward Industries into a global pool-equipment producer. By 2015, Frances was serving with siblings Robert and Carol as treasurer and trustee of their father's charitable institution. This gave her an established governance role before the family's business was sold.

Her present platform, the Mustang Foundation, is run without paid officers: Turner chairs it, Paul is vice-president, and Karla and Andrea Arria-Devoe hold the other board posts. Estate-linked resources have supported a wider grant programme, including theatre, local social services and animal protection. The structure extends the Davis tradition through volunteer stewardship across multiple causes.
